children.name: Story Seed
children.description: Defines what a story is, the kind of narration it should produce, and the essential information needed to recreate it.

children.name: Story Settings
children.description: User-controlled options that determine how a specific story is experienced without redefining the story itself.

children.name: Fate Survival
children.description: A narrative pressure system layered on top of any genre.

children.name: Story Blueprint
children.description: The structured information generated from a Story Seed that the system uses to construct and continue the story.
